why: 1.0.0-beta.2: profiles on the Share page, 3 more alerts

args.notes:
WoWFA Forever 1.0.0-beta.2 (beta).

New: My profiles on the Share page. Write a name and press Save: every current setting (sections, display, colours, all sizes, alerts and system lines, NPC name and map label choices) is kept under that name. Each saved profile has its own Apply button (one click puts it back) and Delete button (press twice). Profiles are shared by all characters of the account, at most 10.
New alerts in Persian: "Your pet is dead. Use Revive Pet.", "You do not have a pet to summon.", "Discovered: <zone>" (the zone name in Persian too).
Includes everything of 1.0.0-beta.1.

Report a wrong NPC name with /wowfa target.

Data from ForeverDB.net
